eyebrow: The one thing Azure SQL Database can't do
code:
-- On-prem: back up to a storage account
BACKUP DATABASE [SalesDB]
TO URL = 'https://mystorageaccount.blob.core.windows.net/backups/SalesDB.bak'
WITH CREDENTIAL = 'MyAzureCredential';

-- On Managed Instance: restore from that URL
RESTORE DATABASE [SalesDB]
FROM URL = 'https://mystorageaccount.blob.core.windows.net/backups/SalesDB.bak'
WITH CREDENTIAL = 'MyAzureCredential';
caption: Native T-SQL BACKUP/RESTORE, pointed at blob storage — the direct payoff of higher parity.
